rule.basis: committed files only: the programs each college's capture listed (the gap census's committed universe)
rule.passing: coverage and invented true, arithmetic equal or unstated (the Program Requirements tab's own test)
rule.overall: catalog source + program requirements passing + (SLOs + PLOs) / 2, divided by 3 (the whole-harvest rule); TBA until the three parts are read per college
rule.confidence: strong = 5 of 5 spot-checked records agree; partial = a difference or an unreachable page; limited = machine checks only, or 2 or more differ (display held)

tba.confidence: No spot-check receipt is committed yet (kb/spot_checks/). COBIx's tallies sit on the wave pull requests; confidence reads strong, partial or limited once a receipt is filed.
tba.overall: The overall bar averages catalog source, program requirements and outcomes (SLOs and PLOs averaged). Catalog source, SLOs and PLOs per college are live tables, read in a later slice.
tba.teachout_approved: Teachout and Approved programs are counted apart from Active in the live COCI table, which this slice does not read.
tba.apis: The API connection checklist (#3220) is not a committed file yet.
tba.jst: The JST funnel waits on an authorized-student feed from CCCStart; counts only, when it exists.
